title: Assess Credential Risk
description: Examine the compromised credentials used in the unauthorized access attempts to determine the level of risk involved.
recommended_next_focus: Implement additional security measures to mitigate credential exposure.

title: Review Logging Gaps
description: Inspect the CloudTrail logs for any gaps or anomalies that might indicate ongoing unauthorized access attempts.
recommended_next_focus: Ensure comprehensive logging is implemented to prevent future breaches.

title: Investigate Correlated Identity Activity
description: Explore the IAM activities associated with the unauthorized access attempts to identify affected resources.
recommended_next_focus: Secure the impacted resources and investigate further if necessary.
